#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, B;
    std::cin >> n >> B;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int c0 = 0, c1 = 0;
    std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<int>> q;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            c0++;
        } else {
            c1++;
        }

        if (c0 == c1 && i < n - 1) {
            q.push(std::abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
    }

    int cnt = 0, sum = 0;
    while (!q.empty() && sum + q.top() <= B) {
        sum += q.top();
        q.pop();
        cnt++;
    }

    std::cout << cnt << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
